items.title: Zillow’s New Zero-Down FHA Loan Comes at an Interesting Time
items.author: Colin Robertson
items.content: Zillow’s lending department, known as Zillow Home Loans, or ZHL for short, just rolled out a way for eligible home buyers to get an FHA loan with no money down. items.title: Mortgage Rates Catch a Small Break Despite Hot GDP
items.author: Colin Robertson
items.content: Mortgage rates are a hair better today, with bond yields moving back below 5% on cooler-than-expected inflation. At last glance, the bellwether 10-year bond yield was down about six basis points to around 4.98%. That’s thanks to a mixed bag of economic reports released this morning, including PCE and GDP. items.title: Mortgage Rates Back on the Rise After Biggest Bond Rally Since 2023
items.author: Colin Robertson
items.content: Bonds had one of their best days yesterday in more than three years. The 10-year yield plunged nearly 20 basis points, its biggest one-day drop since March 2023, even falling below 5% in the process.
